item.title: Guwahati Among Several NFR Stations to Launch Biometric Attendance for Ticket Checking Staff
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) has completed full biometric integration for Ticket Checking Staff across its network, including major stations in Guwahati. item.title: Bharalumukh Railway Gate No. 7 Road in Shambles; Confusion Over Jurisdiction Delays Repair Work
item.description: GUWAHATI: The road near Bharalumukh Railway Gate No. 7 has fallen into severe disrepair, causing daily inconvenience to commuters and residents as authorities continue to pass responsibility for its repair. For nearly four months, the stretch—particularly between Vinayak Furnishing and Om Departmental Store—has remained riddled with potholes and broken surfaces, turning into a bottleneck during peak traffic hours. item.title: PM Narendra Modi to Inaugurate Guwahati Airport’s New Terminal, Lay Foundation of Namrup Fertiliser Plant on Dec 20–21
item.description: GUWAHATI: The new terminal of Guwahati Airport is expected to become operational later this month with its inauguration by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The prime minister will visit Assam on December 20-21 to dedicate the terminal to the people and also lay the foundation stone of the ambitious ammonia-urea fertiliser plant at Namrup. item.description: GUWAHATI: Tezpur University’s students, teachers, and staff have firmly pushed back against Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma’s recent comment on the ongoing unrest. item.title: Over 1,000 IndiGo Flights Cancelled; Airline Issues Apology Letter
item.description: GUWAHATI: IndiGo’s ongoing operational crisis deepened on Friday, with total cancellations since Tuesday surpassing 1,000 and more than 400 additional flights scrapped this morning, according to national reports. The disruption, now entering its fourth straight day, has left thousands of domestic and international passengers stranded at major airports with minimal updates from the airline.
